_comment: TLS fingerprint from 2026-05-06 passive collector run; original capture artifact was not committed and is now lost (predates the _field_sources convention; superseded by planned full re-capture per W11-F-F1-status.md §12.6 Owner decision 2026-05-26). ALPN + h2_settings reality reconfirmed 2026-05-26 by server-side option (b) capture: real claude --version 2.1.112 driven via ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL + NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS subprocess against h2_capture_server.py; alpn_negotiated=null across 5 connections proves only http/1.1 ALPN is advertised + h2 is never established.

_field_sources.tls: DIRECT first-party capture: tools/fingerprint-collector/captures/clienthello-1779786896.jsonl (2026-05-26 §13 full-recapture, mitmproxy 12 + capture_tls_clienthello.py addon, driven by claude.exe v2.1.112). Cross-verifies the original 2026-05-06 passive-collector values byte-for-byte: cipher_suites (17 entries identical), extensions (15 IDs in identical order), supported_versions, curves, sig_algos all match. The original /tmp/fingerprint-data/anthropic-tls/* path is no longer needed (was lost; superseded by the new committed jsonl).
_field_sources.alpn_protocols: DIRECT first-party capture: tools/fingerprint-collector/captures/clienthello-1779786896.jsonl (2026-05-26 §13 full-recapture run). Driving client: claude.exe v2.1.112 via HTTPS_PROXY=mitmdump@18099 + capture_tls_clienthello.py addon. Captured ClientHello shows alpn_protocols=['http/1.1'] verbatim (mitmproxy reads offered ALPN extension contents directly, not negotiated result). Matches existing template value byte-for-byte. Earlier option (b) capture (h2-server-1779775310.jsonl) corroborates h2 absence; §13 capture upgrades the evidence from inference to direct observation.
_field_sources.h2_settings: capture: same source as alpn_protocols above. Because CC CLI never negotiated h2 in any of 5 connections, no HTTP/2 SETTINGS frame was sent; h2_settings.available=false matches first-party reality (not a measurement gap).
_field_sources.method_notes: h2_capture_server.py terminates TLS with self-signed cert + ALPN=h2 only; verified working against undici (captures/h2-server-1779761396.jsonl) and httpx (captures/h2-server-1779774012.jsonl) both negotiating h2 successfully — server-side ALPN advertisement is functional, the null result is therefore client-side absence of h2 ALPN.

h2_settings.limitation_note: collector v1 无 TLS 解密材料，HTTP/2 SETTINGS 为空是预期行为。
